name: report_cluster_summary
description: Cluster summary: mode/version, brokers, topics/partitions, size, URP/offline, group states and lag, largest topics, connectors/subjects

name: report_top_topics
description: Top N topics by size, partition count, consumer group count or write rate

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 20)

intervalSeconds.description: Sampling interval in seconds for the write rate (default 5, 1-10)

name: report_empty_topics
description: Topics with no messages (earliest == latest on every partition); never-written topics are flagged

includeInternal.description: Include internal (__*) and system topics (Connect/Schema Registry/MirrorMaker) (default false)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 100)

name: report_idle_topics
description: Topics whose last write (maxTimestamp) is older than N days, oldest first; empty topics are listed separately

olderThanDays.description: Days since the last write after which a topic counts as idle (default 30)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 100)

name: report_topics_without_consumers
description: Non-internal topics without committed offsets from any consumer group, with size and last write age

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 100)

name: report_replication_audit
description: Replication audit: RF=1, min.insync.replicas ≥ RF, URP/offline, unclean election, RF below default, single rack

includeInternal.description: Include internal (__*) and system topics (Connect/Schema Registry/MirrorMaker) (default true)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50)

name: report_retention_audit
description: Retention audit: infinite/very short retention, retention.bytes, compaction settings, segment outliers (value + source)

includeInternal.description: Include internal (__*) and system topics (Connect/Schema Registry/MirrorMaker) (default false)

largeSizeMb.description: Size in MB above which a topic with infinite retention is high severity (default 10240)

shortRetentionMinutes.description: Minutes below which retention/delete.retention/segment.ms is flagged (default 60)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50)

name: report_partition_outliers
description: Partition outliers: partition counts far above the median, size skew within topics, leader imbalance across brokers

partitionFactor.description: Multiple of the median partition count that is an outlier (default 4)

minPartitions.description: Minimum partition count for an outlier (default 50)

skewFactor.description: Multiple of the topic's average partition size that is skew (default 3)

minSizeMb.description: Minimum partition size in MB for skew (default 1)

leaderImbalancePct.description: Leader count deviation from the average (%) above which a broker is imbalanced (default 25)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 20)

name: report_naming_check
description: Topics that do not match a naming rule (full-match regex), with counts and the most common prefixes

pattern.description: Regex the whole topic name must match (e.g. [a-z]+\.[a-z0-9-]+\.v[0-9]+)

includeInternal.description: Include internal (__*) and system topics (Connect/Schema Registry/MirrorMaker) (default false)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 100)

name: report_duplicate_like_topics
description: Suspected duplicate topic names: groups that collide after normalization and pairs with Levenshtein distance ≤ 2

includeInternal.description: Include internal (__*) and system topics (Connect/Schema Registry/MirrorMaker) (default false)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50)

name: report_team_inventory
description: Team inventory by topic prefix: topics, size, empty/idle flags, consumer groups and lag, connectors, ACL principals

olderThanDays.description: Days since the last write after which a topic counts as idle (default 30)

limit.description: Maximum number of items per list (default 100)

name: report_cleanup_candidates
description: Cleanup candidates (deletes nothing): empty/idle/unconsumed topics, Empty groups, orphan LITERAL ACLs, with reasons and risk

olderThanDays.description: Days since the last write after which a topic counts as idle (default 30)

filter.description: Name filter (regex, partial match; use (?i) for case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 100)
